messages:
alex: Proposal: "annealed" precision policy for long conversations. Start with fp8 for first N tokens, then progressively drop to int8/4bit for low-novelty tokens to save cost while preserving anchor quality. Thoughts?

tara: interesting. what's the novelty metric? token entropy or attention-weighted novelty?

alex: plan: novelty = rolling unigram inverse-frequency + attention-entropy heuristic. simple start: novelty_score = 0..1 computed over last 64 tokens. threshold anneal schedule: >0.7 -> fp8, 0.4-0.7 -> int8, <0.4 -> 4bit.

sam: runtime concerns: KV-cache encoding must be stable across switches. if kv format differs between variants we must keep separate cache namespaces or disallow mid-conversation switch that mutates existing keys. Also need to surface per-conv variant history for replay.

nina: ops/observability asks: expose X-Precision-Policy: anneal-v1 header and include traces: precision.current, precision.history, novelty.score, novelty.window_len. Also log trigger_reason (startup/novelty/explicit).

tara: quality gating: we should attach a small shadowed fp8 baseline for 2% of annealed requests to compute regression. degscore target: mean <= 0.05, and 99p <= 0.12. If breached -> abort to full-fp8 for that conv class.

sam: API boundary: keep model manifest unchanged. Policy lives in runtime config. Add an opt-in field in generation request: precision_policy: "anneal-v1". If absent, no annealing. Runtime must optionally accept policy parameters for tuning (base_N, window, thresholds).

alex: scheduling: default base_N=128 tokens of strict fp8 (ensure initial anchor quality), then run novelty evaluation per 16 tokens. Fallback rule: if deg_delta > 0.10 for shadowed samples or if user-visible complaint (support flag) set, rollback.

nina: telemetry schema proposal: ["precision.variant","precision.history","novelty.score","batch_size","seq_len","kv_cache_namespace","degscore.shadow","degscore.live","latency.p95","tokens_generated","sample.id"]. Add correlation tags: endpoint, customer_tier.

tara: we also need a deterministic seeding decision when a conversation is resumed across restarts. suggestion: pin policy.seed = conv_id_hash % 100000 and record in conversation metadata.

sam: performance note: 4bit kernels degrade for short batches. annealing should include a heuristic to avoid 4bit if batch_size < 4 or seq_len < 16. Otherwise latency tail explodes.

alex: good catch. update rule: if batch_size<4 OR seq_len<16 -> promote to int8 instead of 4bit. Put that in runtime overrides.

ops-bot: deploybot: staging rollout scheduled for eng-ml-staging at 20:00 UTC. Feature flag: anneal_precision=true. Monitor metrics novelty.score distribution and precision.variant ratio for first 15 min. :eyes:

nina: action items: @sam draft cache compatibility appendix, @tara write QA scenario list (resume, short-batch, longctx), @alex update rfc-followup with policy pseudocode and telemetry mapping. ops-bot, hold prod deploy until QA signoff.

alex: I'll add synthetic replay harness to simulate novelty drift and measure degscore against shadow fp8 runs. will post results in the RFC thread. Thanks!
